set.approach: Park in the roadside pullout with a garbage bin on Highway 16 east of Jasper, just past the bridge, and take the main hiking trail that starts behind the lot. The crag soon appears ahead. Where the trail forks faintly below a rolling rise, go right, then work up switchbacks and over a meadow to the wall. Cinquefoil Left lies on the far side of the thick tree at the base, away from the center sector. Cailyn's Route is the furthest-left bolted line, up an arete into chimneys and onto a pillar.

review.notes: Approach from the crag area page plus the route page for where it starts.
